For people who have spent their days delivering at work and now need a practical way to prepare for the next opportunity. Build confidence in focused sessions, practise under exam conditions, and learn from every attempt.

Short sessions count. Consistency beats cramming.

Your data stays in this browser

Learner profiles, bookmarks, and progress are saved locally in this browser on this device. They do not sync to another phone or computer, and may be lost if browser storage/site data is cleared, private browsing is used, or the device is changed. This prototype does not provide secure accounts or cloud backup.

CSV export: downloads the saved attempt history with date, mode, correct answers, total questions, and percentage score. It does not include answer-by-answer selections, explanations, bookmarks, or profile data.

Question coverage & readiness

120 practice questions

The bank now contains 120 practice questions across four domains, including numerical operations, percentages, interest, ratios, averages, vocabulary, grammar, reading inference, deductive logic, sequences, probability, workplace judgement, ethics, customer service and controls. This is a broad practice resource, not an official or exhaustive syllabus. The new questions are model-authored and should be independently reviewed by subject experts before being treated as verified exam material.

Quantitative ReasoningNumerical operations, rates, percentages and basic financial arithmetic.
Verbal ReasoningWord relationships, vocabulary, sentence completion and language logic.
Analytical ReasoningDeduction, statements, logical conclusions and pattern-based reasoning.
Psychometric & SJTWorkplace judgement, collaboration, adaptability and professional scenarios.

Protect your focus

Stress & peak-performance toolkit

Work pressure and high-stakes exams can be difficult to balance. Use small, repeatable habits to prepare with structure.

Slow breathing

Sit comfortably and breathe gently in for four counts and out for six for a minute. Stop if you feel dizzy.

Move on strategically

If you have no clear path after about 90 seconds, flag the question and move on. Return if time remains.

Reframe the task

Treat the exam as a skill you can practise. Focus on preparation, pacing, reviewing mistakes, and rest.

Help us improve the practice bank

Report a question or request help

Use this form to report an incorrect question, answer, explanation, accessibility issue, or technical problem. The form opens your email application; nothing is submitted automatically and no support inbox is configured in this offline prototype.

Please do not include passwords, sensitive personal data, or confidential employer information.

Before public launch

  • Have a qualified subject expert verify all questions, answer keys and explanations.
  • Confirm written permission to publish the supplied logo and any third-party content.
  • Test the complete learner journey on representative phones and desktop browsers.
  • Complete keyboard, screen-reader, modal-focus, contrast and narrow-screen accessibility checks.

These are launch requirements, not checks that this standalone file can certify by itself.

Learner profiles

These are local practice profiles, not secure login accounts. For public Netlify sign-up/sign-in and cross-device progress, connect a real authentication/database service (for example Supabase) before launch.
